subject: the GSPC measurement MCP server (remote https://councilof.ai/mcp; stdio npm csoai-gspc-mcp)
method: Public GETs; one MCP initialize + tools/list to our own endpoint. Descriptions recorded verbatim. A surface that does not answer is SEARCH_INCONCLUSIVE; absence only from a complete listing or a search that returned results.

live_endpoint.instructions: GSPC MCP. 12 free read-only tools and 4 paid x402 tools. Call tools/list for the current definitions. Call a paid tool without x_payment for its payment challenge; payment comes from the caller's wallet. Payment travels as the x_payment ARGUMENT; each implementation sets the X-PAYMENT header itself. A 402 challenge is not settlement, delivery or revenue. Measurement, not certification; verification stays free. witness_hash is quarantined and not advertised. MCP Registry server.version identifies this Pages HTTP implementation; npm is a separately versioned implementation.

csoai/gspc-mcp.description: Independent AI-governance measurement MCP over streamable HTTP (https://councilof.ai/mcp, no auth for the free tools). Free read tools: the live GSPC board totals and axes, signed measurement cards, the public Merkle root and inclusion proofs, card verification under the published Ed25519 key. x402-metered evidence tools: commission a card for a subject, Article 50 marking evidence, RWA evidence, receipt batches — each returns its payment challenge when called without payment. Call tools/list for the current set; https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json lists every door. Measurement, never certification; a grade is never sold; verification stays free. Keywords: AI governance, model safety, EU AI Act, agent verification.

glama.title: Council of AI GSPC by CSOAI-ORG | Glama
glama.overview: Query and verify the Council of AI GSPC measurement board — live totals, axis rows, signed-card verification, and card listings — without certification. Fetch live board totals: slot count and measured count with as _ of dates, or UNREACHABLE if the board cannot be fetched. Get one axis row by name (case-insensitive): n, accuracy, interval, MEASURED/UNMEASURED status, family, and dates; unknown names return the list of available axes. Verify a signed measurement card (object, JSON string, or URL) against the pinned Ed25519 key: VALID, INVALID (with reason), or UNCHECKABLE. List signed-card index rows with declared vs actual counts, optional axis filter and limit, and show disagreements with the card store endpoint without reconciling them.
